n = int(input())
b = int(input())
numbers = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
diff_array = [-1] * n

even_count = 0
odd_count = 0

for i in range(n):
    if numbers[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1
    if even_count == odd_count and i != n - 1:
        diff_array[i] = abs(numbers[i + 1] - numbers[i])
        even_count = 0
        odd_count = 0

diff_array.sort()

sum_cost = 0
total_cuts = 0
for val in diff_array:
    if val != -1:
        sum_cost += val
        if sum_cost > b:
            break
        total_cuts += 1

print(total_cuts)
</translated_code>
